Core Pillar 03 • Real-World Brand vs. In-Universe Lore

The Corporate Entity of Engine Room Records

Because Engine Room Records operates simultaneously as a real-world digital music imprint and as the anchor of a multi-decade literary universe, this page documents the exact boundary between real-world legal reality and in-universe narrative lore.

Legal & Canonical Boundary

1. Real-World Brand Name vs. Fictitious In-Universe “LLC” Entities

Layer A • Real-World Fact

Engine Room Records (Never “LLC”)

In real life, there is only Engine Room Records (strictly without “LLC”). It is the real-world creative brand name under which Michael P. Ragsdale distributes his original music catalog across global DSPs and The Listening Room.

All real-world copyright, commercial Suno AI studio clearances, and ISRC assignments are held directly by Michael P. Ragsdale.

Layer B • In-Universe Fiction

Engine Room Records, LLC & The O'Connell Family Trust

Anything with “LLC”, “Trust”, or “Holdings” in its name is strictly a fictitious, in-universe created entity. In the narrative canon, Engine Room Records, LLC was founded in 1992 by Holly O'Connell to shield The Stardust Engine from predatory record labels, later evolving into the 2015 Delaware holding structure under The O'Connell Family Revocable Trust.

Source: corporate-structure.json • 2015 Delaware Ring-Fence

Stardust Strategic Assets, LLC • Physical Sanctuary Lore

3. Key In-Universe Sanctuary Properties & Rolling Fleet

The Fortress & Stardust Studios (512 Progress St NW, Blacksburg)

In-universe, The Fortress (512 Progress Street NW) is the barrier-free residential compound of the O'Connell and Wright family in Blacksburg, Virginia, paired with Stardust Studios (Global HQ, Est. 2013) and The Vault (subterranean master tape archive). Meanwhile, Stardust Blacksburg, LLC (DBA “The Ironwood Collective”) provides subsidized, wheelchair-accessible housing for CPI students.

The Rolling Sanctuary Fleet (Sainte-Claire 45H3 & Prairie RLFD30)

Operated in-universe by Class A CDL holders Tyler Wright, Evan Wright, and Holly O'Connell: The Iron Horse (a 2002 Sainte-Claire 45H3 45-foot unpainted stainless-steel motorcoach with a custom mid-ship hydraulic wheelchair platform lift for Ryan) and Fleet Unit #1985 (Serial #001 2004 Prairie Coachworks RLFD30 30-foot low-floor urban shuttle with a front-door flip-out ADA ramp).

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
